teaser.en: The coast's kidney beans mostly travel down from upcountry before they are simmered in coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Maharagwe ya pwani kwa sehemu kubwa husafiri kutoka bara kabla ya kupikwa taratibu kwa tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Maharagbwe manji ga pwani nkurehwa kula bara, kabla ya kujitwa pore-pore na huwi.

summary.en: *Maharagbwe* is the common bean, the familiar kidney bean of East African kitchens. On the Digo coast it is mostly bought from upcountry and stewed in coconut milk.
summary.sw: *Maharagbwe* ni maharagwe, yale maharagwe yanayojulikana sana katika jikoni za Afrika Mashariki. Katika pwani ya Kidigo kwa kawaida hununuliwa kutoka bara na kupikwa kwa tui la nazi.
summary.dg: *Maharagbwe* (kpwa Chingereza *common bean* au *kidney bean*) ni maharagbwe ganayomanyikana sana madzikoni ga Afrika ya Mashariki. Pwani ya Adigo manji nkugulwa kula bara, na nkujitwa na huwi.

about.en: *Maharagbwe* is a bean plant that grows as a low bush or a climber. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, and its small flowers are white, pink or purple. The pods are slender and hold several kidney-shaped seeds, which come in many colours: red, speckled, white and brown.
about.sw: *Maharagbwe* ni mmea wa maharagwe unaokua kama kichaka kifupi au kama mmea unaotambaa. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, na maua yake madogo ni meupe, ya waridi au ya zambarau. Maganda ni membamba na hubeba mbegu kadhaa zenye umbo la figo, zenye rangi nyingi: nyekundu, za madoadoa, nyeupe na kahawia.
about.dg: *Maharagbwe* ni mmea wa maharagbwe ambao unamera mfupi photsi, au unakpwera dzulu ya vitu vyanjina. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, na maruwage madide ni mereru, ga pinki au ga zambarau. Makakayage ni membamba, na gana tembe chache za umbo ra figo, za rangi nyinji: za kundu, za mabara-mabara, nyereru na za rangi ya dongo.

where.en: Common beans grow best in cooler, higher country, so on the coast most of the supply is bought from upcountry rather than grown locally. You will find them in every market and shop.
where.sw: Maharagwe hustawi vyema katika maeneo ya juu yenye baridi zaidi, kwa hiyo pwani sehemu kubwa ya maharagwe hununuliwa kutoka bara badala ya kulimwa hapo. Utayakuta katika kila soko na duka.
where.dg: Maharagbwe ganamera vinono zaidi phatu pha mnyevu na pha dzulu, kpwa hivyo pwani manji nkugulwa kula bara badala ya kurimwa phapha. Ganaphahikana chila soko na chila duka.

uses.en: The dried beans are soaked and stewed with coconut milk, a staple dish served with rice or *ugali*.
uses.sw: Maharagwe makavu hulowekwa na kupikwa kwa tui la nazi, mlo mkuu unaoliwa pamoja na wali au *ugali*.
uses.dg: Maharagbwe makavu nkulwekwa madzini, chisha nkujitwa na huwi; ni chakurya cha chila siku chinachoriwa na wari au *sima*.

names.en: Digo: *maharagbwe*, also *maragwe*. Swahili: *maharagwe*. English: common bean or kidney bean. Scientists call it *Phaseolus vulgaris*. The plant comes originally from the Americas.
names.sw: Kidigo: *maharagbwe*, pia *maragwe*. Kiswahili: *maharagwe*. Kiingereza: *common bean* au *kidney bean*. Wanasayansi huyaita *Phaseolus vulgaris*. Asili ya mmea huu ni Amerika.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *maharagbwe*, piya *maragwe*. Kpwa Chiswahili: *maharagwe*. Kpwa Chingereza: *common bean* au *kidney bean*. Kpwa sayansi ganaihwa *Phaseolus vulgaris*. Mmea huno asiliye ni tsi za Amerika.

reason.en: Green gram, another pulse cooked in coconut
reason.sw: Pojo (choroko), nafaka nyingine ya jamii ya kunde inayopikwa kwa nazi
reason.dg: Podzo, nafaka yanjina inayojitwa na huwi.

reason.en: Pigeon pea, the classic coastal pulse
reason.sw: Mbaazi, nafaka ya jamii ya kunde maarufu zaidi pwani
reason.dg: Mbalazi, nafaka ya pwani inayomanyikana sana.

reason.en: Coconut, whose milk is used to stew beans
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tui lake hutumika kupikia maharagwe
reason.dg: Mnazi; huwi ya nazi nkuhumirwa kujitira maharagbwe.
